title: British and Irish players in Serie A since 2000
brief: Name any player from England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland or the Republic of Ireland who played at least one Serie A game between 2000/01 and 2025/26.

notes.Paul Gascoigne: Gascoigne played for Lazio from 1992 to 1995, before this period.
notes.David Platt: Platt's Serie A years (Bari, Juventus, Sampdoria) ended in 1995, before this period.
notes.Paul Ince: Ince left Inter in 1997, before this period.
notes.Ravel Morrison: Ravel Morrison played for Lazio but represents Jamaica, so he isn't counted.
notes.Ademola Lookman: Lookman played for England's youth teams but represents Nigeria, so he isn't counted.
notes.Ola Aina: Ola Aina played for England's youth teams but represents Nigeria, so he isn't counted.
notes.Victor Moses: Victor Moses played for England's youth teams but represents Nigeria, so he isn't counted.
notes.Yunus Musah: Musah played for England's youth teams but represents the United States, so he isn't counted.
notes.Trevoh Chalobah: Trevoh Chalobah joined Como for 2026/27, after this period.
notes.Ronaldo Vieira: Ronaldo Vieira played for England's youth teams but represents Guinea-Bissau, so he isn't counted.

checks: Names come from the England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland and Republic of Ireland sections of Wikipedia's list of foreign Serie A players (which lists players by the country they represent), keeping those whose Serie A years overlap 2000/01 to 2025/26. Every one of the 46 was then found with at least one league appearance in Transfermarkt's season stats for every Serie A club from 2000/01 to 2025/26 (512 club seasons), with a British or Irish citizenship. Transfermarkt also lists 16 players with a second British citizenship who represent another country (for example Lookman, Aina, Musah, Morrison); they are left out. Northern Ireland has no player in this period. Players listed from 2026 only (Trevoh Chalobah, and Harry Winks and Omari Forson's later spells) are counted only for their earlier seasons.
